app.setup.title_default.why: Plain adjectival status, matches Apple's terse ContentUnavailableView titles; no verb needed.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged, distinct from the plain 'disabled' title; says the check failed, not that it's off.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Po włączeniu ochrony strona przestaje przejmować kliknięcia.
app.setup.detail_default.back: After turning-on of-protection the-page stops hijacking clicks.
app.setup.detail_default.why: Impersonal subordinate clause (po włączeniu) instead of addressing the reader with a command.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Safari tym razem nie odpowiedziało. Po włączeniu rozszerzenia aplikacja sama to wykryje.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: Safari did not answer this time. Once the extension is on, the app will detect it by itself.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: Two plain clauses, no error code, reassures without an apology.

app.setup.open_button.why: Short imperative button label, standard Polish Apple button convention.

app.welcome.heading.why: Warmer register allowed only here; product name kept as-is.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Plain noun phrase naming the trick.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Niewidoczna warstwa nad stroną sprawia, że kliknięcie trafia gdzie indziej.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: An invisible layer over the page makes the click land somewhere else.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: One plain sentence, concrete, no jargon.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Two-word noun phrase, matches sibling rows.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Niektóre strony zmieniają cel linku między naciśnięciem a puszczeniem.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some pages change a link's target between pressing and releasing.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Reflexive 'może się zmienić' keeps it impersonal; fits the 50-75 char budget.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Direct equivalent of the English name.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Z włączoną ochroną nowa karta otwiera się tylko tam, dokąd prowadzi twoje kliknięcie.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: With protection on, a new tab opens only where your click leads.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Framed as a promise, as the brief asks, not a description of the trick.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Każdy cel ma wiersz: zezwól na niego lub zablokuj, na jednej witrynie albo wszędzie.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination has a row: allow or block it, on one site or everywhere.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Fits budget while keeping both scopes (here/everywhere) explicit.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Matches the mechanism: guarding is switched on per site.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Naciśnij przycisk Undirect na pasku narzędzi Safari, by chronić daną witrynę.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Press the Undirect button on Safari's toolbar to protect that site.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: Reflexive 'włącza się' is the impersonal construction, not a command to the reader.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Short, won't wrap in a narrow sidebar column.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own Polish term for this screen.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: One word, reused across app and extension for the same concept.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Reads as the clear opposite of 'Wszędzie' beside it.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: A wiring/first-contact state, distinct from 'no rules yet'.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Otwórz dowolną stronę w Safari, a lista wypełni się sama.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open any page in Safari and the list will fill itself.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: 'Wystarczy + infinitive' is the impersonal instruction form, not a command verb.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Terse, distinct from the connection-missing title.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Cel pojawi się tu po zezwoleniu na niego lub zablokowaniu.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: A destination appears here once you allow or block it.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: States how a rule is created, impersonally.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Impersonal past ('zatrzymano'); genitive plural 'prób' is the compromise form — Polish really wants three plural forms (próbę/próby/prób), but only one slot exists here, so the 'many' form is used since it also covers zero correctly.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: Neutral adjectival status word, pairs with 'Dozwolone'.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: One-word imperative menu action, only shown on a Blocked row.

app.rules.row.action_block.why: One-word imperative menu action, only shown on an Allowed row.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: Zezwól na ten cel lub zablokuj go
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: Allow this destination or block it
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Short hover tooltip describing the control's function.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the explicit rule, not setting a new verdict.

app.watched.empty.title.why: States plainly that no site is switched on yet.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Na witrynie, która przekierowuje, naciśnij przycisk Undirect na pasku narzędzi Safari.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: On a site that redirects, press the Undirect button on Safari's toolbar.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Same impersonal 'wystarczy' pattern as the rules empty state.

app.watched.footer.s: Witryny dodasz przyciskiem Undirect w Safari; tu możesz je tylko usunąć.
app.watched.footer.back: You add sites with the Undirect button in Safari; here you can only remove them.
app.watched.footer.why: States the only way the list grows, without addressing the reader directly.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Feminine singular, agrees with 'witryna' (site); read-only status word.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: One-word imperative button, standard Apple convention.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.back: Turns protection off for this site
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes the button's effect for the hover tooltip.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: The master switch label; same noun used throughout for the concept 'guard'.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state word, reused for more than one setting.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Introduces the choice of which sites the guard runs on.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Person's-eye view: the sites they themselves turned on, not a technical mode name.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Names the optional on-page note, separate from the popup's own record.

app.settings.policy_heading.back: By default for destinations without a rule
app.settings.policy_heading.why: Introduces the default-policy choice for a destination with no rule yet.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short imperative picker option, opposite of 'Zezwalaj domyślnie'.

ext.meta.description.s: Nie pozwala stronom wykorzystać kliknięcia do otwarcia innego adresu lub przekierowania.
ext.meta.description.back: Does not let pages use your click to open another address or redirect.
ext.meta.description.why: One sentence for someone who has never used the extension; slightly more explanatory register.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name, same proper noun.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the current on-state as the icon's accessible name.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as the call to action, since pressing the icon here is what turns guarding on.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains there's nothing to guard on a tab with no website.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Explains, as the popup's own headline, that this tab has no website.

ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Open a website and press here.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: Reflexive 'naciska się' keeps the instruction impersonal while still pointing at the button ('tu').

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Names what the switch controls, for a screen-reader user with no visual context.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.s: Nie ma tu strony do ochrony.
ext.popup.watch_unknown.back: Not there-is here a-page for protection.
ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Explains why the switch is disabled: no page to guard.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the per-site switch is redundant because the global mode is already on.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Explains the switch is disabled by the master setting, not this site.

ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms state and warns of the reload, nominalized subject instead of addressing the reader.

ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct before/after pair with watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Heading for the current tab's own list of attempts.

ext.popup.page_off.s: Ochrona jest tu wyłączona, więc nic nie jest rejestrowane.
ext.popup.page_off.back: Protection is off here, so nothing is recorded.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22 — no code reads it; kept consistent with the other page-section states in case it's wired up later.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Ta strona nie próbowała jeszcze łączyć się z innymi witrynami.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: This page has not tried to reach other sites yet.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly that nothing on this page has tried to reach another site.

ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key, near-duplicate of page_quiet as the brief notes; a deliberately close near-synonym.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Feminine singular adjective, agrees with the implied 'próba' (attempt), for count exactly 1.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Genitive plural, the 'many' form; the compromise noted below covers this pair.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Singular case for the running total of every recorded attempt (blocked and allowed).

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Plural/many case, counterpart to seen_one; same compromise as stopped_other.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Polish 'razy' is invariant for both the few (2-4) and many (5+) cases, so no compromise is needed here.

ext.state.blocked.why: Same status word as app.rules.row.state_blocked, must combine with a following scope word.

ext.state.removed.why: Impersonal past tense, safe standalone status word with no destination to agree with.

ext.scope.here.why: Follows a verdict word, e.g. 'Zablokowane na tej witrynie'.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Follows a verdict word, e.g. 'Zablokowane wszędzie'.

ext.scope.default.why: Follows a verdict word, e.g. 'Zablokowane domyślnie'.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Scoped verdict-menu option, current site only.

ext.action.allow_everywhere.why: Scoped verdict-menu option, every guarded site.

ext.action.block_here.why: Scoped verdict-menu option, current site only.

ext.action.block_everywhere.why: Scoped verdict-menu option, every guarded site.

ext.popup.policy_heading.back: By default for destinations without a rule
ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same phrasing as the app's equivalent heading, for consistency across surfaces.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Zasady bezpieczeństwa tej strony blokują część skryptu, więc ochrona jest tu częściowa.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: The-rules of-security of-this page block a-part of-the-script, so protection is here partial.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Names it as this page's own limitation, not a bug — matches the brief's framing.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Short tag for an invisible clickable element placed over the page.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than the click-catcher tag: any see-through overlay.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: A click the page's own script generated, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Pop-up window opened via the page's own script.

ext.kind.form_submit.why: Hidden form submitted to open a new tab.

ext.kind.href_swap.s: Cel linku zmieniony w trakcie kliknięcia
ext.kind.href_swap.why: Link destination rewritten between press and release.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Navigation fired right after the browser's back gesture.

ext.kind.redirect.why: The core same-tab redirect trick, kept terse to match sibling tags.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: A new tab opened behind the person's press, tab-under style.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: The strongest, earliest kind of block — stopped before it reached the page.

ext.reason.way_back.s: Adres prowadzi z powrotem do tej strony.
ext.reason.way_back.back: The-address leads back to this page.
ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains why a redirect was allowed: it carried its own way back.

ext.reason.sized.why: Explains why a window was allowed: it asked for a deliberate size.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Very short: explains why a destination was blocked.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Explains why an unrated destination went through: the default policy.

ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains why a window was allowed: the site's own code opened it.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: Reused as nav row, screen header, and the back button's accessible label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Conventional Polish label for a chevron-only back button, used by Apple's own products.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Same word as app.rules.grouping.everywhere for the same concept.

ext.action.allow.why: Row menu option, scope already fixed by the section.

ext.action.block.why: Row menu option, scope already fixed by the section.

ext.action.clear.why: Removes the explicit rule so the default policy applies again.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Reused as nav row and screen header, matching Apple's own term.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Same master-switch noun as app.settings.guard_toggle, used both as visible text and sr-only label.

ext.action.report.why: Opens a pre-filled issue in a new tab; nothing sends automatically.
